summary: Agnico Eagle Mines filed a Form 6-K reporting that its subsidiary Agnico Eagle (USA) Limited entered a September 8, 2026 securities and asset purchase agreement to sell the Delta and Helm Bay projects to Vizsla Copper Corp. Consideration comprises 22,523,283 initial common shares (19.99% of Vizsla), 2,903,490 deferred shares subject to disinterested shareholder approval, 3,041,480 warrants at C$1.95 for two years, plus 2.0% Delta and 3.0% Helm Bay net smelter royalties, each 50% repurchasable for C$5 million. The transaction requires TSXV approval and is expected to close in Q4 2026. No board recommendation disclosed.
